chunks: Al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about directing the deceased, so he said:
"Direct the soles of his feet toward the qiblah."

key_terms.اسْتَقْبِلْ: turn or orient toward a direction
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the direction of prayer, toward the Ka'bah
key_terms.بِبَاطِنِ: by the inner part or sole
key_terms.تَوْجِيهِ: positioning or directing the body in a particular direction

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be positioned toward the qiblah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction regarding how the deceased should be positioned. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that the deceased be oriented so that the soles of the feet face the qiblah, indicating the prescribed direction in funerary preparation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.348 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about the positioning of the deceased, and Imam (as) said: "
Direct the soles of their feet toward the Qibla”.
